Current public worldmap · proposals and estimates

statusLegend.stated: Reported current state in the discussion, not independently verified.
statusLegend.speaker_claim: A strategic interpretation asserted in the discussion, not established causality.
statusLegend.inference: Analyst connection across passages; not directly asserted.

assumptions: AI-generated transcript with encoding artifacts and occasional out-of-order timestamps.
Speaker names are not assigned to utterances. Attribution remains unspecified.
Plinko is named at 00:36:32 and 00:37:16; the transcript does not define full organizational/product boundaries.
No SKU catalogue, tool governance, privacy/approval protocol, measured 30% savings, or finalized offer ladder is supplied.

nodes.label: Plinko
nodes.description: Name used in the transcript for the developing proposition; its full scope is not defined here.

nodes.label: B2B tax-firm track
nodes.description: Additional lead sourcing for qualified tax firms handling liens, with list-only or managed-meeting delivery.

nodes.label: B2C coaching / consulting track
nodes.description: Education and coaching being simplified around an AI-workforce outcome; monetization remains under development.

nodes.label: Acquisition channels
nodes.description: Email campaign, dialing, network/referrals, plus coaching events and content.

nodes.label: Market qualification
nodes.description: Segmentation based on firms' existing lien activity and suitability.

nodes.label: Intake reality
nodes.description: Current lead sources, sales bandwidth, and delivery preferences.

nodes.label: Mechanical fit
nodes.description: Whether the service can fill an operational gap.

nodes.label: List vs. booked meetings
nodes.description: Customer does its own outreach from a list or supplier provides meeting booking.

nodes.label: Customer experience
nodes.description: How managing the function feels, including frustration, comfort and burnout.

nodes.label: Growth aspirations
nodes.description: Where the organization or person wants to go, beyond simply adding volume.

nodes.label: Risk-management culture
nodes.description: Tolerance for change, uncertainty and protecting the current operation.

nodes.label: Good-faith trust
nodes.description: Confidence that the partner understands the situation and is there for the customer's success.

nodes.label: Holistic decision gate
nodes.description: Choice shaped by goals, risk, capabilities and relationship, above mechanics alone.

nodes.label: Pricing / objections
nodes.description: Point where engagement reportedly drops and a guard goes up.

nodes.label: Client-quality test
nodes.description: Customer must evaluate whether promised new clients are actually good for its business.

nodes.label: Brand belief / point of view
nodes.description: What the brand stands for and how an apparently impossible outcome becomes possible.

nodes.label: Growth without breaking operations
nodes.description: Prototype B2B positioning: enable growth while respecting current operating commitments.

nodes.label: Build your own AI workforce
nodes.description: Simpler positioning around agents performing workforce functions rather than broad AI education.

nodes.label: Offload up to 30% of the day job
nodes.description: A proposed compelling promise, not a measured result demonstrated by this transcript.

nodes.label: Existing content assets
nodes.description: Core resources, scaffold dictionary, diagnostic, playbooks and agent-running material.

nodes.label: Content-to-problem map
nodes.description: Chart connecting each asset and its sections to technology, usage, problem and level of need.

nodes.label: Obvious / digestible journey
nodes.description: A legible path through the content toward a meaningful before-and-after.

nodes.label: Workflow before-and-after
nodes.description: Concrete domains, support and workflows showing how the user's portfolio changes.

nodes.label: Investment buy-in
nodes.description: Move from merely learning something to investing in a consequential outcome.

nodes.label: Interactive world map
nodes.description: Multi-page repository with a clean system map, pathways and content.

nodes.label: Artifact-supported consulting experience
nodes.description: Use the world map and questions to structure client work and subsequent insights.

nodes.label: Holistic sales playbook
nodes.description: Unblocking shared sales/marketing work at the framework level for reuse and possible sale.

nodes.label: Identity investment / archetype
nodes.description: Seeing a desirable possible self embodied by an archetype and brand representative.

nodes.label: Culture–ecosystem flywheel
nodes.description: Mutually reinforcing culture and ecosystem around a brand belief and identity investment.

nodes.label: Attended Consultations
nodes.description:
id: 1
name: Attended Consultations
status: Testing
quadrant: Market Penetration
served: Firm Owner
operators: Engine + Caller + Jon
outcome: Charge only for a consultation that meets the agreed qualification and attendance rules.
includes: Filing research; Eligible U.S. enrolled-agent / CPA firm criteria; Approved human outreach; Qualification against agreed criteria; Consultation booking; Case-context summary; Attendance record; Billing evidence
priceHypothesis: $350–$450 per attended consultation, with a monthly minimum (est.).
capacityEstimate: 6 setup hours and 4 hours per month per firm (est.). Planning cap: 2 firms.
delivery: The Engine researches and matches records. A human Caller conducts approved outreach. Jon reviews quality, attendance evidence, exceptions and billing.
validationGate: Confirm the buyer is an eligible enrolled-agent or CPA firm before outreach; define qualified consultation, attendance, cancellation window, duplicate handling, replacement policy, billing evidence and dispute rules before each pilot.
evidenceLabels: Active Test; Internal Proof

nodes.label: Plinko Pocket Sensemaker
nodes.description:
id: 11
name: Plinko Pocket Sensemaker
status: Next
quadrant: Diversification
served: Consultant / Fractional Executive / Agency Strategist / Workshop Facilitator
operators: Jon + Hermes-powered Pocket
outcome: Turn an approved client conversation into a clear, evidence-linked, editable consulting presentation and action roadmap.
includes: Transcript intake and evidence extraction; Themes, tensions and assumptions; Actor, dependency and bottleneck map; Executive narrative: situation → problem → options → recommendation → roadmap; Branded editable presentation, speaker notes and source appendix; Consultant review before external sharing
priceHypothesis: $250–$500 per reviewed presentation package (est. pilot price hypothesis).
capacityEstimate: Production and revision hours to be measured per package (est.; not yet set).
delivery: Pocket workspace with Hermes-powered processing, review checkpoints and editable exports. MVP accepts pasted or uploaded transcripts; live voice, autonomous research and complex meeting integrations are out of scope.
validationGate: Run two unrelated paid pilots; measure preparation and editing time, traceability of claims, confidentiality handling, revision load and repeat purchase. Separate direct quotes, consultant interpretations and untested hypotheses.
evidenceLabels: Untested Assumption

nodes.label: Plinko Pocket Operator OS
nodes.description:
id: 12
name: Plinko Pocket Operator OS
status: Next
quadrant: Diversification
served: Solo Consultant / Small Agency Owner / Owner-Operator
operators: Jon + Customer-owned Hermes environment + Pocket
outcome: Keep client context, decisions, approved next actions and recurring briefs in one configured, supported working environment.
includes: Pocket onboarding and client-context setup; Two configured workflow stations: Client Context & Sensemaking; Delivery & Follow-Through; Reusable skills and documented approval boundaries; Scheduled briefs and operating guide; Monthly maintenance with bounded scope; Customer pays model, tool and hosting charges directly or by separate metering
priceHypothesis: $1,500–$3,000 setup plus $250–$500/month bounded maintenance (est. pilot price hypothesis).
capacityEstimate: Setup and monthly support hours to be measured per deployment (est.; not yet set).
delivery: Customer-owned Hermes environment connected to Pocket; scoped Plinko implementation and ongoing support. Not a generic Hermes wrapper or standalone hosting offer.
validationGate: Complete two paid deployments; measure repeatability of installation, isolation, weekly use, reliability and support burden. Keep model, tool and hosting usage separate from Plinko fees.
evidenceLabels: Untested Assumption

worldmapOverlay.status: User public roadmap; offers and estimates are proposals, not transcript statements or proven results

skus.name: Attended Consultations
skus.outcome: Charge only for a consultation that meets the agreed qualification and attendance rules.
includes: Eligible U.S. enrolled-agent / CPA firm criteria
skus.priceHypothesis: $350–$450 per attended consultation, with a monthly minimum (est.).
skus.capacityEstimate: 6 setup hours and 4 hours per month per firm (est.). Planning cap: 2 firms.
skus.delivery: The Engine researches and matches records. A human Caller conducts approved outreach. Jon reviews quality, attendance evidence, exceptions and billing.
skus.validationGate: Confirm the buyer is an eligible enrolled-agent or CPA firm before outreach; define qualified consultation, attendance, cancellation window, duplicate handling, replacement policy, billing evidence and dispute rules before each pilot.

skus.name: Researched Leads
skus.outcome: Deliver researched records that match the firm’s criteria for outreach by the firm’s own team.
skus.priceHypothesis: Per-record price defined in each proposal.
skus.capacityEstimate: 3 setup hours and 3 hours per month per firm (est.). Planning cap: 4 firms.
skus.delivery: The Engine researches, matches and deduplicates records. Jon clears exceptions from the review queue.
skus.validationGate: Define record freshness, required fields, exclusivity, duplicate rules, replacement rules and permitted source use.

skus.name: Signal Feed
skus.outcome: Provide a proposed weekly Monday batch of newly matched filings.
skus.capacityEstimate: 4 setup hours and 4 hours per month per firm (est.). Planning cap: 5 firms.
skus.delivery: The Engine prepares the feed. Jon reviews exceptions and reports activity.
skus.validationGate: Test source reliability, match accuracy, usable-record rate, buyer usage and renewal intent.

skus.name: Lead Leak Audit
skus.outcome: Identify where paid lead opportunities are lost between arrival, response, follow-up and handoff.
skus.priceHypothesis: $500–$750 one time, credited toward SKU 5 if purchased within the stated proposal period (est.).
skus.capacityEstimate: 4 hours per audit (est.). Planning cap: 2 audits per month.
skus.delivery: Written asynchronous review using a questionnaire and an approved CRM export.
skus.validationGate: Define minimum CRM fields, analysis period, data-handling process and the outcome when the export is incomplete.

skus.name: Five-Minute Response
skus.outcome: Send the first approved response within five minutes for eligible inbound leads and place a case brief in the CRM.
skus.capacityEstimate: 10 setup hours and 1 hour per month per firm (est.).
skus.delivery: Jon builds and tests the workflow. Automation runs the approved process.
skus.validationGate: Define eligible leads, supported channels, operating hours, consent assumptions, integration scope, outage handling and response-time measurement.

skus.name: After-Hours Intake
skus.outcome: Reduce missed after-hours enquiries and rebook eligible no-shows.
includes: After-hours response for eligible inbound enquiries (no filing-derived phone outreach limit is implied)
skus.capacityEstimate: 8 setup hours and 2 hours per month per firm (est.).
skus.delivery: Jon builds and tests the workflow. Automation runs the approved process.
skus.validationGate: Define supported channels, consent evidence, escalation rules, usage costs, booking rules and human handoff.

skus.name: Dead-Lead Reactivation
skus.outcome: Test whether compliant reactivation can recover value from eligible past leads.
skus.capacityEstimate: 6 setup hours and 2 hours per month per firm (est.).
skus.delivery: Jon builds and tests the workflow. Automation runs it only for records approved for the relevant channel.
skus.validationGate: Require documented channel eligibility or consent, suppression handling, opt-out propagation, retention rules and legal review before launch.

skus.name: Managed Signal Engine
skus.outcome: Operate a private filing-research environment for one firm.
skus.priceHypothesis: $1,500–$3,000 per month, finalized by proposal and scope (est.).
skus.capacityEstimate: 20 setup hours and 6 hours per month (est.). Planning cap: 1 firm.
skus.delivery: The Engine performs scheduled work. Jon monitors exceptions, quality and reporting.
skus.validationGate: Define hosting, access control, retention, deletion, backup, security, monitoring, incident response and support boundaries.

skus.name: Intake Team AI Workshop
skus.outcome: Help an intake team build and test one scoped AI workflow during a practical working session.
includes: Teaching content is original, synthetic, public-domain or used with written permission
skus.capacityEstimate: 6 hours per session including preparation (est.). Planning cap: 1 session per month.
skus.delivery: Jon prepares and delivers the session.
skus.validationGate: Test willingness to pay, implementation rate, recording permission, preparation time and follow-up support burden.

skus.name: State Lien and Judgment Feed
skus.outcome: Extend the filing-signal model beyond federal tax lien notices for existing tax-resolution firms.
includes: Approved state or local filing sources
skus.capacityEstimate: 12 hours per approved filing source, followed by 4 hours per month per firm (est.).
skus.delivery: The Engine retrieves and matches records from approved sources. Jon extends the workflow and reviews exceptions.
skus.validationGate: Validate access method, terms, commercial reuse, coverage, update cadence, data quality and economics separately for every filing source.
skus.classification: Product Development while sold to existing tax-resolution market; reclassify a new-buyer version as Diversification.

skus.name: Plinko Pocket Sensemaker
skus.served: Consultant / Fractional Executive / Agency Strategist / Workshop Facilitator
skus.outcome: Turn an approved client conversation into a clear, evidence-linked, editable consulting presentation and action roadmap.
includes: Executive narrative: situation → problem → options → recommendation → roadmap
Branded editable presentation, speaker notes and source appendix
skus.priceHypothesis: $250–$500 per reviewed presentation package (est. pilot price hypothesis).
skus.capacityEstimate: Production and revision hours to be measured per package (est.; not yet set).
skus.delivery: Pocket workspace with Hermes-powered processing, review checkpoints and editable exports. MVP accepts pasted or uploaded transcripts; live voice, autonomous research and complex meeting integrations are out of scope.
skus.validationGate: Run two unrelated paid pilots; measure preparation and editing time, traceability of claims, confidentiality handling, revision load and repeat purchase. Separate direct quotes, consultant interpretations and untested hypotheses.

skus.name: Plinko Pocket Operator OS
skus.served: Solo Consultant / Small Agency Owner / Owner-Operator
skus.outcome: Keep client context, decisions, approved next actions and recurring briefs in one configured, supported working environment.
includes: Two configured workflow stations: Client Context & Sensemaking; Delivery & Follow-Through
Reusable skills and documented approval boundaries
Customer pays model, tool and hosting charges directly or by separate metering
skus.priceHypothesis: $1,500–$3,000 setup plus $250–$500/month bounded maintenance (est. pilot price hypothesis).
skus.capacityEstimate: Setup and monthly support hours to be measured per deployment (est.; not yet set).
skus.delivery: Customer-owned Hermes environment connected to Pocket; scoped Plinko implementation and ongoing support. Not a generic Hermes wrapper or standalone hosting offer.
skus.validationGate: Complete two paid deployments; measure repeatability of installation, isolation, weekly use, reliability and support burden. Keep model, tool and hosting usage separate from Plinko fees.

skus.name: First AI Workflow
skus.outcome: Build and test one scoped automation for the learner’s own work across three sessions.
skus.capacityEstimate: 4 hours per learner (est.). Planning cap: 2 learners per month.
skus.delivery: Jon teaches and reviews the build.
skus.validationGate: Test learner completion, time to first working prototype, support burden, willingness to pay and referral intent.

skus.name: Evening Cohort
skus.outcome: Help participants build and test a practical workflow prototype over four weeks.
skus.capacityEstimate: 20 hours to build the initial program and 8 hours per run (est.). Planning cap: 1 run per quarter.
skus.delivery: Jon develops and delivers the cohort.
skus.validationGate: Validate audience acquisition, minimum cohort size, completion rate, support burden and conversion from SKU 13 or the free community.

skus.name: Builders Community
skus.outcome: Test a recurring learning environment built around practical workflow demonstrations and peer progress.
includes: One evening question-and-answer session each month
skus.priceHypothesis: $39 per month for the proposed paid level (est.).
skus.capacityEstimate: 8 hours per month regardless of member count (est.).
skus.delivery: Jon prepares the recordings, templates and monthly live session.
skus.validationGate: Validate recurring engagement, churn, content-production time, and that teaching/community material is original, synthetic, public-domain or used with written permission; permission controls and willingness to pay before launch.
